title: Boy in Davy Crockett Hat, 1950s Suburban House B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Gary - Davy Crockett hat 3 yrs Aug 18, 1955 E654
description: A 1955 black and white snapshot depicting a three-year-old boy named Gary standing on a concrete walkway outside his family's mid-century suburban home wearing shorts and a coonskin cap. The background showcases quintessential 1950s American residential architecture featuring horizontal siding, a brick entryway with a house number plaque, a decorative screen door with a monogram, and manicured landscaping. The Davy Crockett cap reflects the massive 1955 Disney-inspired pop culture craze across American suburbs.
